headline: One month later, what has the "8·28" new policy brought to the property market?
summary: A one-month review examines how the new 8·28 property policy has affected ready-built home sales, off-plan sales, land market activity and second-hand home prices.
why: China's property sector is a large share of the economy, and policy changes there affect developers, banks and commodity demand such as steel and cement.
